articles.title: France orders evacuation of tourist spot as hundreds flee wildfires by boat
articles.description: The fire has raged in the region for several days with officials now ordering the evacuation of the entire Cap Ferret peninsula.

articles.title: US hits dozens of countries with new wave of tariffs
articles.description: Imposed citing forced labour concerns, the levies replace a temporary global duty brought in after the US Supreme Court struck down tariffs in February.

articles.title: Angela Rayner rules out rent controls in England
articles.description: The housing secretary tells the BBC that the Renters Rights' Act is already having a significant impact on the market.
